title: LBAC for Prometheus: no feature toggle, Mimir/GEM backend only
answers: How do I enable Team LBAC / LBAC for data sources on a Prometheus data source?
Why doesn't teamHttpHeadersMimir feature toggle exist anymore?
LBAC rules aren't restricting metrics for a Prometheus/Thanos/Google Managed Prometheus data source
Is LBAC for Prometheus still in private preview?
body:
Symptom: Docs or support requests reference enabling the `teamHttpHeadersMimir` feature toggle to use Team LBAC for data sources, or LBAC rules silently don't restrict query results.
Root cause: `teamHttpHeadersMimir` was fully removed in PR #109240 with no replacement toggle; LBAC enforcement is hard-wired to Mimir-specific HTTP headers (e.g. `X-Scope-OrgID` and team-scoped label matchers) that only Grafana Cloud Metrics (Mimir) and Grafana Enterprise Metrics (GEM) backends honor.
Fix pattern: Any doc, error message, or code comment that still mentions `teamHttpHeadersMimir` or describes LBAC-for-Prometheus as "private preview" is stale and must be corrected to state the feature is GA and gated only by backend type, not a toggle.
Constraints: Applies to Team LBAC for the Prometheus data source specifically; LBAC never works against external Prometheus-compatible endpoints (self-managed Prometheus, Thanos, Google Managed Prometheus) regardless of any toggle, because those backends don't support the Mimir-specific headers.
applies: Team LBAC for data sources / Prometheus data source docs and any code checking Mimir-header-based LBAC enforcement

Symptom: docs/support tickets referencing a `teamHttpHeadersMimir` feature toggle to enable Team LBAC for Prometheus, or LBAC rules having no effect on non-Mimir backends.
Root cause: the toggle was fully removed (no replacement) in PR #109240, but several docs pages still told users to enable it or called the feature 'private preview'.
Fix pattern: Team LBAC for the Prometheus data source is generally available and requires no feature toggle; it only works when the datasource backend is Grafana Cloud Metrics (Mimir) or Grafana Enterprise Metrics (GEM), because enforcement relies on Mimir-specific HTTP headers (e.g. X-Scope-OrgID) that other backends (Google Managed Prometheus, self-managed Prometheus, Thanos) ignore.
Constraints: any doc, UI copy, or support guidance mentioning LBAC for Prometheus must not reference `teamHttpHeadersMimir`; instead state the Mimir/GEM backend requirement. Applies to LBAC docs under data-source-management/teamlbac and datasources/prometheus.
